summary: Everbright Digital Holding Ltd., a Cayman Islands company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of its best-efforts registered offering of 4,293,000 ordinary shares at $1.88 per share, grossing approximately $8.07 million. WestPark Capital acted as sole placement agent, receiving a 6.5% fee and expense reimbursement. The offering was made under an effective Form F-1 registration statement. Post-closing, the company had 5,959,275 shares outstanding. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
